about: Named column-physics profiles behind the hex seam. Each row names the engine selector values a backend row builds its seam with, the MPAS selector spellings its configuration records, the soil geometry and sea-ice switch it integrates, and the orographic statistics file it reads. The dycore never reads this table. A row is what WOOF's own schemes are; it is not a claim of parity with any outside model, and every known difference from the configuration it is shaped after is listed in its row.

suites.describes: WOOF's own HRRR-family column schemes behind the hex seam: aerosol-aware Thompson, MYNN surface layer, MYNN-EDMF, RUC land surface on nine soil levels, the GSL orographic drag suite in the PBL slot, legacy RRTMG. Shaped after RRFS v2's hrrrv5 suite (source profile rrfs-v2); the physics is WOOF's, measured against observations.

engine_batch.first_engine: woof 2.8.8 (not yet published; woof 2.8.7 does not ship woof.core.mpas_column_suite)

differences_from_shaped_after: aerosol-aware Thompson (WRF mp=28 port) instead of TEMPO v3.0.3 with hail and ML droplet number
MYNN-EDMF at the engine's wrf_461 identity instead of MYNN-EDMF c942418; scalar and aerosol mixing off (RRFS v2 mixes aerosols)
GSL orographic drag only (WRF module_bl_gwdo_gsl port, gwd_opt=3); UGWP's non-stationary part is not run
drag scale-awareness uses one nominal dx per mesh; native MPAS uses len_disp/meshDensity**0.25 per cell
drag kpblmax from a standard-atmosphere coordinate of the nominal column
RUC at the engine's wrf_45 soil properties and wrf_461 snow, monthly LAI and albedo off

legacy RRTMG; MYNN's subgrid cloud reaches it through the engine's icloud_bl=1 (part of its MYNN option identity), which is MPAS's cld_fraction_mynn and is recorded so (this row recorded cld_fraction until 2026-10-06, a label the run did not execute)
convection is the configuration's own (Grell-Freitas at 12 km here; RRFS v2 runs new Tiedtke at 12 km)
